title: ChatContact/queryChanges: removed field uses changes.destroyed which is always empty
description: contact.rs ChatContactQueryChangesHandler returns 'removed: changes.destroyed' where changes is a ChangeSet from get_changes_since(). Contacts are never destroyed (destroy is forbidden), so this is always empty in practice. But the semantic is wrong: RFC 8620 queryChanges 'removed' means IDs that fell out of the result set (due to filter or sort changes), not IDs of destroyed objects. When Phase 2 adds contact filtering, a contributor may assume 'removed' is already correctly populated and skip implementing filter-aware removal tracking. The field name 'destroyed' in the ChangeSet struct is misleading. Should either rename the struct field or add a comment explaining why destroyed == removed is correct for this unfiltered query.
